# Open Abundance

> Open Abundance is a free web app (installable PWA) and an open experiment in participation and mutual help. People pick a personal wish, turn it into small daily steps, help each other in small growth circles, and get rewards in an internal balance for verified useful actions. Early pilot; internal rewards are not an investment or a guaranteed return.
